ColonyEventDefinition.Name: Alien Distractions
ColonyEventDefinition.Description: Our recently signed treaty has distracted our citizens from their tasks as they become temporarily preoccupied with the new alien peoples. As a result empire-wide happiness has increased, but research output has decreased.

ColonyEventDefinition.Name: Integration Studies
ColonyEventDefinition.Description: Unassimilated alien populations at our colonies have reduced our empire-wide happiness and decreased our research output.

ColonyEventDefinition.Name: The Answer
ColonyEventDefinition.Description: The recent construction of the Transcendence Hub has provided a boost to our empire happiness

ColonyEventDefinition.Name: A Puzzle Solved
ColonyEventDefinition.Description:
The recent completion of an advanced research project has provided a 2-year boost to our empire happiness and research output.

[BONUS]+10% All Research[/BONUS]
[BONUS]+10% Happiness[/BONUS]

It has also provided [CHARACTER]bonus traits for our Leader and one of our Scientists[/CHARACTER].

ColonyEventDefinition.Name: Building the Future
ColonyEventDefinition.Description: The recent construction of a new research station has provided a short-term boost to our empire happiness

ColonyEventDefinition.Name: Razing the Pirate Prison
ColonyEventDefinition.Description: Our decision to raze the ancient park used by the pirates has provided a short-term boost to our empire happiness

ColonyEventDefinition.Name: Using the Pirate Prison
ColonyEventDefinition.Description: Our decision to use the ancient park used by the pirates has given us a short-term hit to our empire happiness

ColonyEventDefinition.Name: Destroyed the Cybernetic Brain
ColonyEventDefinition.Description: Our decision to destroy the cybernetic brain has provided a 3 year boost to our empire happiness
